content.rendered: Last week, COVID-19 metrics for K-12 schools were announced by Governor Brown, OHA, and ODE, that restrict the reopening of school districts.  In response to these metrics, beginning Monday, August 3 Sherwood School District will put a moratorium on the use of all District facilities.  All SSD facilities are closed to use by outside groups and school sponsored sports and activities until guidance from the Governor, OHA, and ODE indicates that it is safe to do so.  This aligns with the protocols we are seeing in neighboring districts.
